verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API-driven sandbox platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the pack documents one with runnable or try-it examples. SDKs, an llms.txt file, markdown docs and Cursor rule files are adjacent documentation aids, not an interactive reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
